written: 2026-09-05, from the fixture sources, BEFORE the CLI was run (ADR-001 key-first)
question: Does `Model::method()` carry enough evidence to request the model surface, and what boundary keeps that from becoming 'extract every Class::method()'?
the_trap: Extracting a surface for every `Name::member` is NOT acceptable. The key states the wanted OUTCOME per case; the report then measures which candidate boundary produces it. The key does not name a boundary.
evidence_available_at_extraction: Only the changed file's text and its `use` block. The extractor is handed (ChangedFile, ChangedRegion, fileText) and holds a MemberSlicer — no ClassLocator, no SourceRepository. So 'is this an Eloquent model?', 'is it project code?' and 'does the member exist?' are ALL unanswerable at extraction time. Any boundary that needs them must live at resolution.

rows.case: model reached only by a static call
rows.expected_items: the Package SURFACE fetched (fillable, casts, scopeActive) + the existing flag for the unresolved member
rows.why: Experiment 1's earned move: 'The PlaidAccount model — resolves forItem, official_name, fillable/casts.' The diff mass-uses the model; whether those columns exist is off-diff and only the model settles it. Today it fires only when the class also appears in a `new`/type position, which real Laravel code does not do.
rows.must_not: must not be produced by matching the method name

rows.expected_items: surfaces of BOTH Package and Setting fetched + existing flags
rows.why: `create($data)` mass-assigns. `$fillable` is the contract being relied on and it is exactly what the surface carries. Setting is a second, independent model so the result cannot come from one lucky class.

rows.expected_items: no ADDITIONAL surface — Package's surface is already requested by G1.A/B; the flag for ::query is unchanged
rows.why: Three references to one model must yield one surface, not three. De-duplication is already the extractor facade's job.

rows.expected_items: Widget surface fetched — UNCHANGED from today
rows.why: The control. Whatever boundary is chosen must not alter behaviour that Experiment 1 already earned.

rows.case: non-model project class, same member name
rows.expected_items: the `create` MEMBER slice only — NOT the surface
rows.why: THE TRAP ROW. `create` is Eloquent's most recognisable name, and Registry is an ordinary final class that declares it. The member resolves, so the minimal slice IS the member — the spec's 'ideally one method or class member' and Experiment 4's `PlaidClient::createLinkToken`, 'one method (the mode switch)'. Fetching `__construct` and `all` as well would be a new over-fetch.
rows.must_not: must not be classified from the method name, and must not gain a surface

rows.expected_items: exactly ONE flagged item, as today
rows.why: A boundary that also emits a bare-class assertion here would produce a SECOND flag for one reference — a new false positive, and a doubling of the noisiest item type in the bundle.

rows.expected_items: no item — M3's framework-known settlement, unchanged
rows.why: Preserved regardless of boundary. Note a bare-class assertion for Log would be settled by ADR-A012 as a dependency class, so it costs no item — but it does cost a second diagnostic line, which the report should count.

rows.expected_items: ZERO items from any of them
rows.why: The docblock names Package::where() and Log::info(); a comment names Package::create() and Setting::updateOrCreate(); the array holds 'Package::where', 'Package::create' and a `Package::class` constant. None is a reference.

rows.expected_items: bundle_version, schema, assertion kinds, premises, levers, provenance, priority bands and token accounting UNCHANGED
rows.why: M13 is an experiment. Nothing may move at all in this milestone.

candidate_boundaries_to_measure.B0: today — form 3 excludes the static-call position
candidate_boundaries_to_measure.B1: form 3 as the FROZEN table words it — include the static-call position, unconditionally
candidate_boundaries_to_measure.B2: B1, but only when the class resolves to project source (ADR-A012's ownership test)
candidate_boundaries_to_measure.B3: surface requested only when the referenced member cannot be resolved in the class's own file — a resolution-time fallback, not an extraction change
